data.current_description:
Subscribes an HTTPS URL to one or more event types (or ["*"] for all events). This is the subscribe half of the REST-hook pattern integration platforms use: POST the target URL plus the events, store the returned id and secret, and DELETE the endpoint to unsubscribe.

The 201 response is the ONLY response that carries the endpoint's full signing secret (whsec_...) - store it immediately; every later read returns it masked. Use the secret to verify the X-Genaya-Signature header on deliveries (t=unix,v1=hex HMAC-SHA256 of "t.rawBody").

URLs must be https (plaintext http, private/internal addresses, and embedded credentials are rejected with code invalid_url). Unknown event types are rejected with code unknown_event - fetch the catalog from GET /v1/webhook-endpoints/events. Creating an endpoint past the 10-per-org cap returns 400 with code endpoint_limit. Supports the Idempotency-Key header for safe retries. Requires scope: webhooks:write.

Validation: unknown event types return code unknown_event (fetch catalog from GET /v1/webhook-endpoints/events); exceeding 10 endpoints per organization returns code endpoint_limit. The 201 response is the ONLY response that carries the endpoint's full signing secret (whsec_...) - store it immediately; every later read returns it masked. Use the secret to verify the X-Genaya-Signature header on deliveries (t=unix,v1=hex HMAC-SHA256 of "t.rawBody").

URLs must be https (plaintext http, private/internal addresses, and embedded credentials are rejected with code invalid_url). Unknown event types are rejected with code unknown_event - fetch the catalog from GET /v1/webhook-endpoints/events. Creating an endpoint past the 10-per-org cap returns 400 with code endpoint_limit. Supports the Idempotency-Key header for safe retries. Requires scope: webhooks:write.
